info.title: API.SH: Kelley Blue Book
info.description: The Kelley Blue Book API from API.SH: public Kelley Blue Book data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Kelley Blue Book's data for a model year: every trim with its vehicle id, Fair Purchase Price, trade-in and private-party value and specs; price range; depreciation history and resale forecast; 5-year cost to own; the expert review with sub-ratings, pros and cons; consumer rating averages and distribution; safety and crash-test ratings; full specs and features; class rankings; FAQs; photos and the model's other years.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kbb-model

get.description:
Consumer reviews of a model on Kelley Blue Book (the site groups years of the same generation): overall rating and ratings for value, reliability, performance, styling, comfort and quality, title, text, pros, cons, recommendation, ownership, author nickname, helpful votes and photos. Filter by stars, keyword or topic; sort by newest, most helpful or rating. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kbb-reviews

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars (1-5).

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: A topic such as Reliability, Comfort, Value, Interior.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Kelley Blue Book values for one car at a mileage, condition and ZIP: the trade-in value with its range, private-party values (with ranges) for excellent, very good, good and fair condition, the dates they are valid for, and a forecast of private-party and trade-in values for the coming months. Identify the car by `vehicle_id` (from /kbb/v1/model trims) or by `vin`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kbb-values

parameters.name: vehicle_id
parameters.description: Kelley Blue Book vehicle id (trims[].vehicle_id in /kbb/v1/model).

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: 17-character VIN, used when vehicle_id is not given.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition for the trade-in value and the forecast.

parameters.name: annual_mileage
parameters.description: Miles per year for the forecast (default 12000).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Decodes a VIN to Kelley Blue Book's year, make, model, trim, vehicle id (for /kbb/v1/values), vehicle class and option ids.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kbb-vin

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
